'''Business and economy'''
*[[China–European Union relations]]
**The [[China|Chinese]] [[Ministry of Commerce (China)|commerce ministry]] imposes a provisional set of 42.7% [[tariff]]s on dairy products imported from the [[European Union]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-eu-dairy-tariff-ev-b53e2f0afc777b3415eff3823f6a67d0 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 16 people are killed and 18 others are injured, including five critically, when a passenger bus loses control on a toll road, strikes a concrete barrier, and overturns in [[Semarang]], [[Central Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-bus-crash-java-56815beaa357343ad652127c8bb155ad (AP)]
*A [[Mexican Navy]] [[Beechcraft Super King Air]] plane carrying eight people, including a pediatric patient, crashes into a bay while on approach to [[Scholes International Airport at Galveston|Scholes International Airport]] in [[Galveston, Texas|Galveston]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. At least five people are killed, including a two-year-old child, while two others are rescued and another is reported missing. [https://www.chron.com/gulf-coast/article/plane-crash-galveston-texas-bay-21257753.php (''Chron'')] [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/12/mexican-navy-plane-carrying-pediatric-patient-crashes-near-galveston-texas-6-on-board/ (BNO News)] [https://apnews.com/article/galveston-texas-plane-crash-07fbc8ca6632354bb0148df460606c86 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Nuclear power in Japan]]
**The [[Niigata Prefecture|Niigata prefectural]] [[Legislative assembly|assembly]] approves the restart of the [[Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Nuclear Power Plant]], the world's largest [[Nuclear power plant|nuclear facility]], nearly 15 years after [[Japan]] shut down its [[Nuclear reactor|reactor]]s following the [[Fukushima nuclear accident|2011 Fukushima disaster]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/japan-prepares-restart-worlds-biggest-nuclear-plant-15-years-after-fukushima-2025-12-21/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[India–New Zealand relations]]
**[[India]] and [[New Zealand]] finalize a [[free-trade agreement]] aiming to reduce most tariffs on bilateral trades, while New Zealand also pledges to invest US$20 billion in [[Economy of India|India's economy]] over the next 15 years. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-new-zealand-sign-free-trade-deal-with-wellington-pledging-20-billion-investment/a-75265364 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal]]
**The [[High court (Malaysia)|high court]] of [[Kuala Lumpur]], [[Malaysia]], rules that former [[Prime Minister of Malaysia|prime minister]] [[Najib Razak]] must remain in prison, holding that a purported [[Royal prerogative of mercy|royal addendum]] allowing [[house arrest]] lacks [[legal force]] because it was not approved by the pardons board, as required under the [[Constitution of Malaysia|constitution]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysias-ex-pm-najib-face-two-key-court-rulings-1mdb-saga-2025-12-22/ (Reuters)]
